1  -2-  MFA No. 4088 of 2019  THIS MFA IS FILED UNDER SECTION 173(1) OF MV ACT AGAINST THE JUDGMENT AND AWARD DATED 06/08/2018,
PASSED IN MVC NO.191/2014 (OLD MVC.NO.204/2011), ON THE FILE OF THE SENIOR CIVIL JUDGE AND MACT,
KANAKAPURA, PARTLY ALLOWING THE CLAIM PETITION FOR COMPENSATION AND SEEKING ENHANCEMENT OF COMPENSATION.
 THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY,
THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 JUDGMENT 1.
The claimant is in appeal seeking for enhancement of compensation.
2. The Tribunal after noticing that the claimant has suffered fracture of mandible on left side and sub condylar fracture on right side has awarded a sum of Rs.60,000/- as global compensation.

3. In my view, having regard to the fact that the Doctor, who was examined as P.W.2 has stated that the claimant had suffered fracture of the mandible on left side and sub condylar fracture on right side which are grievous in nature, it would be appropriate to award a sum of Rs.80,000/- as global compensation instead of Rs.60,000/-.

Sd/-
JUDGE HNM Kumar vs Rajashekariah on 20 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/7804907/
